---
type: Fixed
pr: 3018
---
**Gap-closure plans generated by `/gsd-plan-phase --gaps` now deterministically carry `gap_closure: true`** — the planner's frontmatter validator previously only checked plans against a schema that never required this field, so a gap-closure plan could silently omit it and `/gsd-execute-phase --gaps-only` would then match zero plans with no error. (#2847)
